subject: Re: CitadelPay evaluation — security onboarding checklist & target close timeline
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@citadelpay.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@citadelpay.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CitadelPay security onboarding questions and timing

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency/throughput profile. Before we progress to a legal review and PoC kickoff, security needs a quick read on a few items to slot the evaluation into our quarter close. High level asks: 

- Current SOC 2 Type II report (or a summary)
- SIG/CAIQ answers or an estimated timeline to deliver
- Draft DPA we can review + any standard redlines Redwood requests
- Data retention defaults for embeddings and token logs, and controls for customer-managed keys

Can you share the above and a suggested MAP with dates? We are targeting a procurement decision by the end of Feb if evidence looks reasonable.

Best,
Anna
Anna Lopez
Head of Security, CitadelPay
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@citadelpay.com>, Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@citadelpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CitadelPay security onboarding questions and timing

Anna — thanks for the clear list. I talked this over with our security and legal teams and sketched a short mutual action plan (MAP) and evidence bundle that should get you to procurement by month-end if we keep to the cadence below. Attaching a SOC 2 summary and an initial SIG/CAIQ export (answers v1) for review.

Proposed MAP highlights (week-by-week):
1) Feb 10 (today): Deliver SOC2 summary + SIG/CAIQ v1 + draft DPA redline (attached).
2) Feb 11–13: CitadelPay reviews SIG answers + DPA redline; security Q&A checkpoint (30m).
3) Feb 16: We provide any requested clarifications and updated SIG answers; provide KV/cloud-region mapping and KMS docs.
4) Feb 17–18: Legal runs DPA redline & procurement creates PO if acceptable.
5) Feb 19: Target contract signature or mutually agreed next-step (short extension if needed).

Key compliance notes up-front:
- SOC 2: Redwood has a Type II report (summary attached); full report available under NDA.
- SIG/CAIQ: We can commit to a completed spreadsheet within 48 hours of your questions; v1 is attached to speed triage.
- DPA: The attached proposed redline shows our standard data retention defaults: token logs retained 30 days by default, embeddings retained 365 days, and customer can elect shorter windows. We support customer-managed keys (KMS) in our Private offering.

Please confirm whether the timeline above meets your procurement deadlines. If you want, Marissa from our CS team can join the security checkpoint to walk controls and runbook items.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-type2-2025-summary.pdf; SIG-CAIQ-answers-v1.xlsx; DPA-proposed-redline.docx
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@citadelpay.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@citadelpay.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CitadelPay security onboarding questions and timing

Vivek — appreciate the quick turnaround and attachments. Quick read-through comments from our side: 

- SOC2 summary looks fine; we will request full report and NDA if we move forward.
- SIG v1: a few items we flagged under Network Security controls and key rotation cadence (row 42, 58). Can your security engineer confirm rotation cadence for service keys?
- DPA redline: our legal has a couple of asks on subprocessor disclosure cadence and breach notification SLA (we typically ask 72 hours).

Can Marissa join a 30m sync tomorrow (Feb 12) at 10:00am PT for the technical walkthrough? If so, we can run through flagged SIG items and call out anything that will block our SSO/PO timeline.

Thanks,
Anna
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@citadelpay.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:59:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CitadelPay security onboarding questions and timing — technical sync confirmation

Anna, Vivek — confirmed: I’ll join tomorrow Feb 12 at 10:00am PT. Karthik (security engineering) will be on the call to address rotation cadence and network questions. Agenda (30m):

- 0–5m: Introductions and objectives for MAP timeline
- 5–15m: SIG/CAIQ quick review — rows 42 & 58, plus any high-priority gaps
- 15–25m: DPA redline highlights (subprocessors, breach notif SLA) and where we can offer mitigations or contractual language
- 25–30m: Action items and updated MAP milestone assignments

Deliverables from our side by Feb 16: updated SIG workbook (v2), KMS/key-rotation doc, and a DPA response checklist for your legal.

See you tomorrow — calendar invite sent.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@citadelpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CitadelPay security onboarding questions and timing — SIG answers v2

Anna — following our sync, attached is SIG/CAIQ v2 with targeted clarifications (network controls, key rotation cadence). Short answers:

- Service key rotation for internal service accounts: automated rotation every 90 days; customer KMS keys (customer-managed) are on customer cadence but we validate rotations during onboarding.
- Network controls: we use private subnets for dedicated deployments and default deny Egress rules for host-level management hooks; we documented the ports/processes in the workbook.
- Breach notification: Redwood’s standard timeline is 72 hours for confirmed incidents; we can accept 72-hour notification SLAs in the DPA.

I’ll drop the updated workbook to the shared Drive link and can provide deeper evidence (config snippets) under NDA if needed.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIG-CAIQ-answers-v2.xlsx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@citadelpay.com>, Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@citadelpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CitadelPay evaluation — contract timing check and next steps

Anna, Ethan — thanks again for the fast review. Per our commitments in the MAP, we delivered SIG v2 and confirmed the 72-hour breach notification SLA and 90-day rotation for Redwood service keys. Next items to close this sprint: 

- Your legal to confirm DPA redline (we accepted 72-hour breach SLA and will provide subprocessor list weekly during onboarding).
- Procurement to issue PO or confirm a short extension if additional legal review is required.
- If helpful, we can provision a short (2-week) dedicated sandbox with restricted dataset for CitadelPay to run an acceptance test — Marissa can scope this.

Targeting signature/PO by Feb 19 as discussed. Please flag any blockers.

Best,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
